task_description: Build NeuroPipeline - Agent 2 of the BioMed Research Agent Suite. A Streamlit-based code-generation agent that consumes Agent 1 (NeuroInspect) JSON reports and generates complete, runnable ML pipelines for EEG/ECG datasets. Features visual pipeline builder, live code preview, one-click execution, and zip export.

verification.summary: All 234 pytest tests pass in 0.18s. Pipeline planner correctly maps DREAMER->gat_tcn, MIT-BIH->cnn1d_lstm. All Jinja2 templates render to valid Python. UI components and styles verified. All modules importable.
